title: STERNBERG DIFFICULT
description: Raw EEG recordings from participants performing a Sternberg working memory task with Russian consonant letter sets of 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15 items. Each participant completed 200 trials across five difficulty blocks. Raven's Progressive Matrices scores are provided for each participant in participants.tsv.
methods_description: Participants performed a Sternberg task during EEG recording. Each trial had a 500-1000 ms fixation cross, then 1500 ms encoding, 2000 ms retention, and 1500 ms retrieval (probe letter). Participants answered yes or no with arrow keys. There were 200 trials in total, 40 per set size, in random block order with equal numbers of positive and negative probes. Stimuli were presented with Psychopy2. Triggers mark only stimulus onset, so retention and retrieval onsets must be computed from the trial design (1500 ms and 3500 ms after the trigger).
